artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: ISSUER AMENDMENT 3 (CTO R-38/R-49/R-51 precondition 3, drained add_security @8c75f4f90d): run() now makes EXACTLY ONE call per run. Every effectively-EVIDENCED row (effective_state_and_reason == STATE_EVIDENCED, root/cc both present -- amendments 1 and 2 unchanged) is collected, in the rows' own order, into a request list [{folder, bloomberg: '<root> <cc>'}, ...] written to induction_batch_<as_of>.json under this worker's deliverables dir; when the list is non-empty, ONE call `call(['--batch', <path>, '--as-of', as_of, '--write-pool'])` is made (NO call when the list is empty -- proven by a call that raises if reached). The captured stdout is split by the new `_split_batch_blocks` on each request's own 'bloomberg_calls N' line (a MEASURED block's 'mode ...' line trails AFTER that line and lands in the trailer, never mis-assigned to the wrong request, since block boundaries are counted, not content-matched) and the blocks are assigned to the requests IN ORDER; a block count that differs from the request count marks every request in that batch `error` with a `block count N != request count M` reason, never a guess (new `test_run_block_count_mismatch_errors_every_unassigned_request`). The trailer's own 'BATCH: requested N landed L bloomberg_calls C pool_puts P' line (new `_parse_batch_line`) yields `pool_puts`; its absence sets pool_puts 0 and increments errors by exactly one (new `test_run_missing_batch_line_counts_as_an_error_and_zero_pool_puts`). Per-row `rc` is now null (the rc is the batch's, carried at document['batch']['rc']); the read-back document gains a top-level `batch` object {file, requests, argv, rc, landed, pool_puts, bloomberg_calls}. The totals line gains `batch_calls` (1 iff a call was made) and `pool_puts` between `bloomberg_calls` and `sum`, per the amended AC2 expect. `_build_call_argv` (the per-row --folder+--bloomberg argv builder) is RETIRED -- superseded by the batch request list; no per-row call is ever made. make_fake_call() (no longer taking `rows`) now scripts the --batch shape directly off the batch file's own contents: asserts --batch present, --folder/--bloomberg absent, reads the named file, asserts every request carries folder + a parseable bloomberg, and prints MEASURED/already-registered/REFUSED/MEASURED... blocks by request POSITION (index 1 -> already-registered, index 2 -> REFUSED, every other index -> MEASURED), each closed by its own 'bloomberg_calls 0' line, then one 'BATCH: requested N landed L bloomberg_calls 0 pool_puts 0' line (L = count of scripted MEASURED blocks) and the max rc (4 iff any block is REFUSED). Measured on the real 93-folder library via --dry-run --as-of 2026-09-24 (run 3 times across this session, byte-identical totals line every time): population 60 evidenced 20 ambiguous 2 (Copa CPA, Uber Technologies UBER US) disagreement 1 (America Movil AXMB MM) other 37 called 20 registered 18 already_registered 1 refused 1 errors 0 bloomberg_calls 0 batch_calls 1 pool_puts 0 sum 60 -- unchanged from amendments 1/2 on every field except the two new tokens, as the amendment predicts (R-49's own count-first collision read found 0 of 20 evidenced keys colliding, so no ENRICH fork applies here).

20 tests (18 prior + 2 new), offline, under tests/conftest.py's autouse poison plus the add_security._load_blp_client positive control: (1) rows_for_run wiring, unchanged; (2) run() now exercised against a hand-scripted `call` reproducing add_security's OWN --batch printed-line grammar (`_scripted_batch_call` helper, reading the batch file the run() under test wrote, printing per-request blocks in file order exactly as add_security.main does, including the 'mode APPEND' line trailing AFTER 'bloomberg_calls N'); NEW test_run_makes_no_call_when_no_effectively_evidenced_rows proves the call is never reached and batch_calls reads 0; NEW test_run_block_count_mismatch_errors_every_unassigned_request proves a genuine block/request-count mismatch marks every affected row `error` with the block-count reason, never a guess; NEW test_run_missing_batch_line_counts_as_an_error_and_zero_pool_puts proves an absent BATCH: line yields pool_puts 0 and errors += 1 while the single present request block still parses correctly; (2a, ISSUER AMENDMENT 1) parse_folder_token / effective_state_and_reason unchanged; test_run_reclassifies_disagreement_and_never_calls_it now asserts against the batch file's own contents (America Movil AXMB MM's folder is asserted ABSENT from the written batch request list, never merely 'not called with argv X'); (2b renamed from 2c, ISSUER AMENDMENT 3 supersedes 2's --folder+--bloomberg per-row tests, RETIRED with _build_call_argv) test_run_refuses_rootless_row_before_ever_batching_it proves a root/cc-less EVIDENCED row is refused before ever being placed in the batch request list, `call` never reached; (3) make_fake_call (no `rows` argument) scripting every outcome branch by request position off the written batch file, asserting the ONE call's argv carries --batch and neither --folder nor --bloomberg, and NEW test_make_fake_call_makes_no_call_when_batch_empty proves it is never invoked when nothing is effectively evidenced;
